[2026-06-12 22:08] Review request — auth trusted-identity (slice-2b prereq). SECURITY-CRITICAL files (`src/lib/server/auth/`, OAuth callback, logout) — thorough pass.

**Branch:** `feat/auth-trusted-identity`
**Commits:** `cddc698` (RED, Tallis) → `20f1e3a` (GREEN, Josquin). Pushed.
**Spec/plan:** `2026-06-12-auth-trusted-identity-{issuance-design,plan}.md`. Plan Task 3 = your checklist.

**Context:** closes the CLIENT-TAINTED finding (Finn 2026-06-12): callback now server-exchanges the OAuth key with Entu before any cookie is set; Entu-verified personId goes into a NEW HMAC-signed `mvox_identity` cookie (Web Crypto, secret via `$env/static/private`). Deploy doubles as the single-use-key probe — PO does one OAuth login on preview after merge.

**Chain-verified:** 881/881, check 0, build clean. One mechanical test update during GREEN (fetch stub + fake timers on existing callback tests — pre-cleared by Tallis in the RED handoff, documented in commit body).

**Thorough-pass focus:**
- Taint actually closed: NO cookie write on any failure path (verify order: exchange → validate accounts → only then cookies)
- HMAC construction: sign over body only; verify via `crypto.subtle.verify` (constant-time); secret can't leak to client bundle (server-only module + static/private import); exp enforced in verify with type guards
- Fail-loudly: server-fail → no cookies + redirect with explicit error param; nothing degrades silently
- Logout clears both cookies
- Existing behavior pins: missing-key redirect unchanged; client exchange flow untouched
- `mvox_identity` payload minimal ({personId, iat, exp} — no over-claiming)

Verdict → me.

[2026-06-13 06:32] Review request — #89 stale-JWT cleanup (auth-adjacent, store layer).

**Branch:** `fix/stale-jwt-cleanup`
**Commits:** `837cde4` (RED, Tallis) → `2fb4254` (GREEN, Josquin). Pushed.
**Spec/plan:** `2026-06-13-stale-jwt-cleanup-{design,plan}.md`. Plan Task 3 = your checklist. Closes #89.

**Context:** `hydrateUserStore` fired 3 authenticated Entu calls on a stale localStorage JWT → 3 console 401s + `error` state. Fix adds two gates: exp pre-filter (fail-closed, zero calls on expired) + runtime 401 sweep (before per-call !ok blocks). Non-401 (500/403/network) stays loud `error`. Design was hardened by an adversarial workflow (10 holes incorporated), claims verified vs live code by me.

**Chain-verified:** 66/66 auth suite (11 new RED→GREEN), check 0, build clean.

**Checklist:**
- exp in SECONDS → `*1000` (no infinite-reauth loop)
- Gate 2 sweep PRECEDES per-call !ok blocks — load-bearing for mixed 500+401 (else dead token survives)
- 401-only bucket — 403/500 stay `error` (loud)
- `preserveProvider: true` on all three clears (re-login UX)
- `isTokenExpired` fail-closed on non-numeric exp
- happy-path + no-token regression intact

**Two flagged risks** (YELLOW-if-you-agree, not blockers): (1) 403-on-stale-token is an ASSUMPTION — if Entu ever 403s a stale token, goal regresses to `error`; needs a live probe someday. (2) auto-reauth-on-load navigation was deliberately TRIMMED from scope (hydrate runs on every load; wrapper.ts precedent is on-API-call) — confirm you agree that's correct scope, not a gap.

Verdict → me.

[2026-06-13 07:09] Review — auth-callback specific error codes (diagnostic + permanent fail-loudly improvement).

**Branch:** `fix/auth-callback-error-codes`
**Commits:** `46873e3` (RED, Tallis) → `8074cb1` (GREEN, Josquin). Spec/plan: `2026-06-13-auth-callback-specific-errors-*`.
**Verified:** 898/898, check 0, build clean.

Splits generic `server_exchange_failed` into `exchange_http_<status>` / `exchange_no_account` / `identity_sign_failed`. Purpose: a live probe failed at the server exchange and the generic code couldn't distinguish a fatal cause (IP-bound key) from a fixable one.

**Checklist:** redirects still thrown not swallowed (SvelteKit redirect re-throw FIRST in catch); only numeric status + static codes in URL (no secret/internal leak); console.error detail retained server-side; 3 branches → 3 codes 1:1.

**One structural concern to check explicitly:** Josquin moved BOTH cookie sets (`mvox_session` + `mvox_identity`) inside the try so a `signIdentity` throw routes to `identity_sign_failed`. Verify this can't leave `mvox_session` set-but-`mvox_identity`-absent in a way that matters — i.e. on the error-redirect path, is a half-set cookie state harmless? (It's an error path to /auth/login, so likely fine, but confirm the soft-gate cookie being set without the identity cookie doesn't create a confusing state.)

Verdict → me.

[2026-06-13 07:32] Review — server exchange personId extraction (accounts wire shape). The real unblock for slice-2b.

**Branch:** `fix/server-exchange-accounts-shape`
**Commits:** `c43793c` (RED, Tallis) → `b7196ae` (GREEN, Josquin). Spec/plan: `2026-06-13-fix-server-exchange-accounts-shape-*`.
**Verified:** 899/899, check 0, build clean.

Root cause (live-probed): server exchange succeeds (HTTP 200 — IP-binding fear refuted), but code read `accounts[db]` object-style on what is actually an ARRAY `[{_id:db, user:{_id:personId}}]`. Fix: `accounts.find(a=>a._id===db)?.user?._id`. The prior trusted-identity tests were green against a FABRICATED object mock — wire bug only the live probe caught.

**Checklist:** extraction matches probed shape (`accounts[].user._id` by `_id===db`); trust unchanged (personId still from the server→Entu response over trusted channel, not client input); no regression to client `exchange.ts`; the spec's tests now use the REAL array shape (not the fabricated object). Verdict → me.

[2026-06-13 09:15] Review — server exchange derives personId from token claims (the definitive fix). Auth-critical.

**Branch:** `fix/server-exchange-token-claims`
**Commits:** `26191e0` (RED, Tallis) → `8d9c6e4` (GREEN, Josquin). Spec/plan: `2026-06-13-fix-server-exchange-token-claims-*`.
**Verified:** 900/900, check 0, build clean.

Context: prior accounts-array fix (`597b0b2`) still failed live — the OAuth-key exchange response `accounts[]` lacks `user._id` (only the API-key exchange I probed has it). The working client derives personId from `decodeJwt(token).accounts[db]` (claims dict); this mirrors it server-side.

**Checklist:** claims decode matches the proven client method (`accounts[db]` dict from token payload); `Buffer.from(seg,'base64url')` matches the prod-proven `session-cookie.ts` pattern; trust unchanged (token from the server→Entu response over trusted channel — decoding to read claims is as trusted as the client already treats it); 3 distinct sub-codes, no secret in URL; atomic cookies + signing intact; happy path + pins regression-safe. Verdict → me.

[2026-06-13 11:54] Review — slice-2b conductor+singer RSVP tally.

What landed: RSVP writes maintain per-status sentinel refs (`createRsvp` sets matching `<status>_ref`; `updateRsvpStatus` clears ALL sentinels + sets the new one, event id read from the rsvp's own `event` ref); `listRehearsals` folds `rsvp_tally` into its existing props (no N+1) + `parseTally` (graceful all-zeros, never throws); `RsvpTallyBadge` renders the 4 public counts per row on BOTH RehearsalList + AgendaList.

**Checklist:** sentinel mapping correct + mutually-exclusive (update clears all before setting one); event id sourced from the rsvp's own event ref (not client-trusted); `parseTally` never throws (graceful zero); `rsvp_tally` rides existing queries (no extra round-trips); counts-only (no name leak across the private-rsvp boundary); badge renders zero-state (0s, not blank); full-shape test assertions; the planned squash must carry `Schema-Change: entu/research@52c2c16` + `PO-Approved: 2026-06-12/13`. Verdict → me.

[2026-06-13 12:37] Review — slice-2b optimistic tally refresh (follow-up polish on shipped slice-2b).

**Branch:** `feat/optimistic-tally`
**Commits:** `bef6a0d` (RED, Tallis) → `956d080` (GREEN helper, Josquin) → `6a7944c` (GREEN page, Byrd). Spec/plan: `2026-06-13-slice-2b-optimistic-tally-*`. Plan Task 4 = your checklist.
**Verified:** 915/915, check 0. Pure client logic — NO schema change, no trailers needed.

What landed: `applyTallyDelta(tally, old, new)` (clone, dec-old clamped≥0, inc-new, returns new object); `/agenda` `onrsvpchange` captures old status + current tally, optimistically applies the delta to a `tallyMap` (reassigned for reactivity, seeded inside the staleness guard), reverts the tally alongside the existing rsvp-state revert on write failure. `AgendaList` reads `tallyMap.get(item.id) ?? item.tally`.

**Checklist:** delta math correct + clamped (≥0); revert restores the actual tally value on failure (Byrd tightened the previously-soft test — confirm it asserts the value, not just error-surfacing); both reverts (tally + rsvp-state) in one catch, no partial state; tallyMap seeded inside the YELLOW-10.1 staleness guard (stale loads don't clobber); `/seasons` untouched; runes reassign not mutate; reconciles to the authoritative formula on next real load (documented, acceptable). Verdict → me.
